steps.en: Install, then pick a model provider, risk profile, memory and agent
steps.zh: 安装后选定模型提供方、风险档、记忆和 agent

steps.en: Store the Telegram bot token, enable the channel and bind it to the agent
steps.zh: 保存 Telegram 机器人 token，启用渠道并绑定到 agent

steps.en: Start the daemon and send the printed one-time code to your bot
steps.zh: 启动守护进程，把打印出的一次性码发给机器人

steps.en: Admits only bound senders and routes each message to the agent and model
steps.zh: 只放行已绑定的发送者，把消息交给 agent 和模型

steps.en: Rates each tool call by the risk profile and asks you in chat for medium-risk ones
steps.zh: 按风险档给工具调用评级，中风险的在聊天里问你

steps.en: Runs approved tools, in a sandbox when one is available, and replies in the same chat
steps.zh: 执行获批工具，有沙箱时在沙箱里跑，并在原聊天回复

value.en: One always-on assistant on your host that acts through chat, with risky steps waiting for your OK
value.zh: 主机上的常驻助手通过聊天办事，有风险的步骤先等你点头
